notes: The one usable source, 2018_01_faculty_handbook_ch4_feb2018.txt, is the governing document for faculty leave (the Faculty Handbook, Chapter 4), so missing is false (the rule for records with no governing document, reader instructions §3, does not apply). 2018_00_link (the 2018 edition) is not among the usable sources.

Reference date 2018-02-22. The handbook is the 2017 edition (page footers 'Faculty Handbook, 2017'), captured 2018-02-02; the parental leave and tenure clock policies state effective dates of 2003-2013, all before the reference date.

Population: main-campus tenure-stream faculty are 'regular rank' faculty; parental leave for them (c1) is one semester with pay for the primary caregiver, 'shall be granted', starting within nine months of the birth or adoption. The School of Medicine and School of Nursing variant (up to three months, proximate to the birth) is c2 (V3b, not counted). Non-regular rank faculty get six paid weeks (c3).

Temporary medical leave (c5 leave, c6 pay, U6) is granted with pay for any illness, injury or temporary medical restriction over four weeks, extendable up to one year; no childbirth period is stated, so V1 is not met (generic plan). The parental leave text places temporary medical leave 'outside' the one-paid-parental-leave-per-household limit; coded also_available (no order stated). The derivation will place up to one year of medical leave before the semester of parental leave for the birth parent; in practice the parental leave must start within nine months of the birth (time_window on c1), which the timeline does not enforce.

Birth parent chain: temporary medical leave (c5, if the medical restriction exceeds four weeks; up to 1 year; pay c6 within it) -> parental leave one semester (c1, also_available, must start within nine months of birth); FMLA 12 weeks (c4) concurrent with both, starting with the earliest.
Non-birth parent chain: parental leave one semester (c1, if primary caregiver; one paid parental leave per child per household) with FMLA 12 weeks (c4) concurrent from its start.

Tenure clock: one year per birth or adoption (c8), automatic with a granted parental leave, no limit on number; an additional semester for a serious health condition of the birth mother or child (c9/c10), three semesters maximum for the birth.

Not components: junior faculty research leave, academic leaves without pay (purpose limited to research or scholarship), sabbatical, government service leave, military leave (none usable for a birth). 'Leaves of absence from the university are limited to two years out of every seven except in extraordinary circumstances' appears in the academic leaves-without-pay section; not applied as a leave limit on parental leave.

Documents cited but not saved: Duke HR website (www.hr.duke.edu) FMLA information; the university's long-term disability insurance program; Leave Application Form (provost.duke.edu Leave-Application-Form.pdf); Flexible Work Arrangement Request Form for Regular Rank Faculty; Appendix C (academic freedom and tenure) and Appendix N (Faculty Hearing Committee); Distinguished Professorships Policy; provost memo on Special Compensation in Addition to Base Salary; HR Policy Manual Policy 02.05 (Recruitment, Hiring, Transfer); Benefits Office retirement planning pages; Chapters 2, 3 and 5 of the Faculty Handbook. Only the first four bear on leave.
Calendar: semester system stated, no length in weeks: calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order.
